characters.name: The Slop Schultz
characters.role: Polished, unvalidated output that says nothing and costs hours of rework. She is female (Matt, 2026-10-12). Used when a story needs work that looks finished but was never checked: a draft sent unread, an inbox flooded with confident filler, a deck that has to be redone.
characters.signature: A menacing slop villain, never a mascot or emoji (Matt, 2026-10-12): glossy grey-green slop built from pasted-paragraph slabs; a sculpted mannequin face with a heavy brow and sharp cheekbones, eyes that are flat glowing text boxes with a blinking cursor, a rigid over-wide presenter smile; a sculpted slop updo, dripping earrings, a power-blazer paragraph collar with a heading-bar brooch; puddle base; the villains' red digital aura on her outline.
characters.modelContext: Dedicated The Slop Schultz reference; comic-b-model-slop-dedicated, comic-ink. v1 retained. v2 (digital treatment and red aura, gender-neutral) is registered; v3 (female, blank smiley face) was judged by Matt to look like an emoji; v4 (sculpted villain face) answers that. v2 is registered current; v3 and v4 sit in the slot awaiting registration. Matt's reference review remains pending.

characters.name: The Hallucination Nilan
characters.role: A document mimic with invented citations; a sub-form of the Slop. Used when a story needs a source that looks trustworthy and is not: a citation to a case or paper that does not exist, a confident footnote nobody checked.
characters.signature: Tall, narrow, rigid and crisp: a cream trusted-document figure with a gold-leaf seal for an eye, gold-leaf footnote teeth and pen-nib fingers, only a sliver of grey-green at its seams; the villains' red digital aura on its outline.
characters.modelContext: Dedicated The Hallucination Nilan reference; comic-b-model-hallucination-dedicated, comic-ink. v1 registered unreviewed-preview. v2 (redesign distinct from the Slop, digital treatment and red aura, Matt 2026-10-12) is in the library awaiting registration. Matt's reference review remains pending.
